annotations.title: Reconcile Invoice Receipt Against Official 1x Rate Card

description: Reconciles one API invoice line against the selected model and billing channel using exact fixed-point decimal arithmetic. Stateless read-only audit that never fabricates rates for unknown models or missing channels and defaults to the dated packaged snapshot when channel is omitted. Returns JSON with status (RECONCILED, ESTIMATE_ONLY, or MISSING_MODEL), exact_usd decimal strings, variance_usd, and rate_source provenance. Use this tool to verify an actual billed invoice amount against rate cards; use analyze_same_model_cache instead when measuring same-model cache vs uncached counterfactuals.

actual_billed_usd.description: Optional actual USD invoice amount in decimal string notation (e.g. '0.0025'); omit to compute rate-card estimate only.

cached_tokens.description: Subset of prompt_tokens served from warm prompt cache.

channel.description: Billing channel ('packaged-snapshot' by default, or exact live feed channel such as 'openrouter' or 'direct:openai').

completion_tokens.description: Output completion tokens generated by the model for this request.

model.description: Exact billed provider/model ID (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-2024-11-20'); missing IDs are never guessed.

prompt_tokens.description: Legacy inclusive total input tokens, including cached_tokens.

usage.description: Optional native provider usage object (Anthropic separate input/read/write buckets or OpenAI inclusive prompt_tokens) used instead of flat legacy token fields.

cached_tokens.description: Cached read tokens subset of prompt_tokens.

name: reconcile_usage_receipt
